title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling API requests with JSON or URL-encoded data, allowing yantraverse to parse and make the data available to route handlers. It will improve the framework's usability and compatibility with modern web development standards. By adding this feature, yantraverse will be able to handle a wider range of API requests
testCases: Test invalid JSON parsing error handling
acceptance: The feature is accepted when route handlers can successfully access and use the parsed request body data for both JSON and URL-encoded requests
reason: This feature is essential for building RESTful APIs and supporting modern web development workflows, making yantraverse more attractive to developers and improving its overall competitiveness in the market
